callouts.label: Check-in and setup
callouts.hint: A laptop with a prompt, in the shortest session block at the start.
callouts.description: 8:30 to 9:00. Teachers leave with: a working agent session.
callouts.tip: Everyone leaves this block with a working session, so nothing later is blocked by setup.

callouts.label: The ten metrics
callouts.hint: A sheet of ten small boxes in two rows, the first arc starts here.
callouts.description: 9:00 to 9:45. Teachers leave with: a rubric card.
callouts.tip: Arc 1: the rubric comes before calibration, so teachers have a human score to compare the agent with.

callouts.label: Calibration by hand, then with the agent
callouts.hint: Bars of unequal heights under a dashed line, where the first arc lands.
callouts.description: 9:45 to 10:45. Teachers leave with: hand and agent scores, with gaps explained.
callouts.tip: Teachers score a sample by hand first, then with the agent, and explain the gaps.

callouts.label: Checking the agent
callouts.hint: A page under a magnifying glass, where the second arc starts.
callouts.description: 11:00 to 12:00. Teachers leave with: a verified evaluation of the sample.
callouts.tip: Arc 2: checking comes before improving, so teachers fix a resource only after they trust the evidence.

callouts.label: Lunch
callouts.hint: A plate with a knife and fork in a dashed block.
callouts.description: 12:00 to 12:45. Teachers leave with: no deliverable, just a rest.
callouts.tip: Breaks and lunch are drawn short on purpose so the blocks stay in proportion to time.

callouts.label: The improvement challenge
callouts.hint: The longest block, with a wrench and a staircase of bars, where the second arc lands.
callouts.description: 12:45 to 2:15. Teachers leave with: an improved component and its new score.
callouts.tip: The longest block, because teachers do the real work here.

callouts.label: Peer review and publishing
callouts.hint: Two people and an upward arrow.
callouts.description: 2:30 to 3:15. Teachers leave with: a published, openly licensed component.
callouts.tip: Peer review comes after the improvement challenge, so reviewers have something to review.

callouts.label: Next steps
callouts.hint: The smallest block at the right end, with a small certificate.
callouts.description: 3:15 to 3:30. Teachers leave with: a certificate checklist.
callouts.tip: The exit survey measures only the first level of training evaluation.
